newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE's ENOC plans to market lubricants abroad - paper.
newsitem.headline: UAE's ENOC plans to market lubricants abroad - paper.

text.p: The Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC) is planning to market lubricants outside the United Arab Emirates within three months, the government-owned Emirates News said on Friday.
ENOC in January set up a joint venture with Caltex to produce and market engine oil and lubricants. Caltex is a 50-50 joint venture between Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc.
ENOC chief executive Hussain Sultan said EPPCO Lubricants, a new division of ENOC and Caltex, would initially market lubricants in Gulf Arab states and the Middle East.
"Later on we will market our products in India and the CIS," the daily quoted Sultan as saying.
Sultan said EPPCO Lubricants would concentrate on the upper end of the market by providing high-quality, low-cost products.
He also said the company would invest $100 million on developments over the next three years. He did not elaborate.
